status: FROZEN BEFORE FIRST FORMAL MARKET FIT
new_candidate: SMP: context-conditioned finite signed/zero-age Markov reward mean propagation trained on multi-horizon price risk
novelty_boundary: Structural hypothesis only. Markov reward recurrence, signed hurdle/exponential marks, GRU, weighted least squares and auxiliary likelihood are established components. No originality or publication claim without strong empirical attribution.
data_exposure: The five development files were previously used; 2022 and 2023 are not untouched tests. EEX2024/2025 remain unopened for model use. Shanghai confirmation was previously exposed.
series_dependence: EEX and EU_REPORTED are related EU ETS targets, not independent markets; no IID market or seed significance inference.
candidate_input: 20 shared history tokens; past60-increment origin RMS; full-prefix last nonzero sign and capped age; training-prefix fixed statistics; observed past calendar gaps and EEX historical auction covariates. No future quotation dates or actual future covariates.
training: Separate annual model per series. Only labels strictly before year-start cutoff; last80 mature origins validation; remove training origins whose fullH20 label reaches validation origin. No model updates during evaluation year.
model: GRU32 frozen current context inside each forecast, 9 sign-age states, age cap2, softmax q0/q-/q+, softplus b-/b+ +1e-4, zero age advances, nonzero resets sign and age0, exact20-step expectation
model_support: Point forecasts of cumulative observed net price change, not transaction arrivals. State3/4 are nominal general states usually unreachable at actual t>=60.
supplemental_baseline: Existing project causal state-space reference uses its predefined filter/window/selection rule and longer history; reported separately, not a same-information ablation.
patchtst_adapter: Unchanged author core 204c21efe0b39603ad6e2ca640ef5896646ab1a9; all shared channels, RevIN=False, C-to-1 supervised readout, d_model16/one block/two heads/patch5 stride5. This is an author-core task adaptation, not an author benchmark reproduction.
score: Equal average across five series and h1/5/20 of raw-price MSE / same-cell RW_MSE. Average per-seed risks before series average; seeds are not additional observations.
native_loss: mean_t,h((s_t*m_t,h-delta_t,h)^2 / V_train,h) + alpha*mean_t,h((s_t*m_t,h)^2/V_train,h); V_train,h=mean_train(delta_h^2), fixed training floor. one_step takes h1 only; GRU_normalized mean((m-y)^2/h)+alpha*mean(m^2/h).
auxiliary_controls: All SMP except no_aux and the directGRUaux use exactly the same .05 one-step hurdle NLL and raw 1e-10 event mask. DirectGRUaux has unconstrained 20-step head; no_aux isolates extra likelihood.
head_initialization: Every neural predictor starts at exact RW point means; SMP/GRUaux q0 from training zero frequency clip[.001,.95], equal negative/positive probabilities and common training normalized absolute mark mean.
D2_job_generation: For each family, union of its D1-selected shrink and SMPfull D1-selected shrink; 5series x3seeds. No same-config duplicate fits. All5ridge values for train-validation-selected reference plus fixed D1-global ridge. Statistical predictions are not rerun for seeds.
gate_interpretation: Prespecified resource/evidence gates, not universal publication thresholds. Stop fixed candidate if gate fails; retain every result; do not rescue by new alpha/seed/objective/benchmark choices.

uncertainty.method: Joint calendar circular moving-block bootstrap; same sampled day weights for all series; average seed squared errors first; recompute each cell denominator inside every replicate
comparisons: SMP vs D1 fixed best non-SMP baseline
uncertainty.interval: percentile95% per difference; require both upper97.5 percentiles<0 for additional confirmation resources
uncertainty.calendar_grid: complete natural evaluation year Jan1-Dec31, including dates with no evaluation origin; these dates do not become zero-return observations
uncertainty.invalid_replicate_policy: Record and reject a replicate if any series has no weighted origins or a zero RW denominator; stop if 2000 valid replicates are unavailable within10000 attempts
uncertainty.gate_uses: 28-day primary only; report14/56-day sensitivity without replacing primary

confirmation_rule: Only after D2 point gate + independent full metric audit + both prespecified block-interval upper bounds<0; freeze separate exact C model/data/fit count protocol first. No C discovery, selection or numerical access in this source.
failed_fit_policy: Every attempt remains in ledger; nonfinite and incomplete runs ineligible. No automatic retry or result-dependent source edits. A real implementation defect requires a recorded protocol revision and independent review, never silent overwriting.
publication: Public source/protocol/hash/aggregate errors; all per-origin quotes/forecasts/scales/model weights local_only. No raw EEX redistribution.
validation_score_explicit: For every neural checkpoint and local ridge_val alpha choice, equal mean h1/5/20 raw-price MSE divided by validation same-cell RW MSE; distinct from all20-horizon training loss.
deadline_semantics: Cooperative budget. A new worker job or training batch does not begin after its deadline check. Already started validation/restoration/prediction/closed-form work may finish slightly later; no hard process kill is claimed.
